items: 12.2.1 Lim_{x->a} (x^n - a^n)/(x - a) = n a^(n-1) where n is a non-zero integer and a > 0

12.2.5 Methods for Evaluating the Limits at Infinity
12.2.9 If theta is measured in radian, then Lim_{theta->0} sin(theta)/theta = 1.
